messages.author: 7152eacbc3ebed68
messages.subject: deployApp()  Error.
parts:
deployApp() is giving the following error==> Error: Unable to retrieve package records for the following packages:
- 'ReadImages'
I am facing this error for every other Shiny App.
I installed rsconnect.
ReadImage package was removed from CRAN repository. 
I tried to install an archived version but it failed.
Looking forward to your inputs. Thanks a lot!

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] deployApp() Error.
parts:
It looks like that package was removed from CRAN in 2013 because it was orphaned. I suggest you find replacement package and update your code to a supported package.

Other then that, you could try installing the package using:

devtools::install_version('ReadImages', "0.1.3.3")

This might let let shinyapps detect the package, but its a long shot at this point.

-Andy

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] deployApp() Error.
parts:
Packages that are removed from CRAN do not have pre-built binaries, so you're going to need to satisfy the build dependencies yourself (libjpeg) so the package can be compiled.

I highly recommend you find a supported replacement package. This is not a shinyapps.io issue.
